summary: Successfully debugged and fixed 'Data Not Showing' issue. Root cause was ObjectId serialization error in backend APIs. Both Referensi and Barang pages now display data correctly.

critical_bugs.issue: ObjectId serialization error causing 500 Internal Server Error
critical_bugs.impact: Prevented all data from displaying on frontend
critical_bugs.solution: Added ObjectId to string conversion before JSON serialization

passed_tests: GET /api/referensi - returns 13,783 records with proper pagination
GET /api/barang - returns 45 records with proper pagination
Frontend Referensi page displays data correctly (20 rows, proper pagination)
Frontend Master Barang page displays data correctly (20 rows, proper pagination)
Response format matches expected { data: [], total: ... } structure
Database contains proper data (13,634 kodefikasi, 45 barang records)

success_percentage.integration: 100% (frontend successfully fetches and displays backend data)
